text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: 'I don't think that driverless cars are a good investment'","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"States a direct, unmistakable position early so the reader knows exactly what the essay is arguing."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on awareness, laziness, control, safety, and money","quality":"organized development","description":"Builds the argument through separate, focused points instead of circling around the same idea."},{"evidence":"'Some people would have to agree...' followed by rebuttal","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"Acknowledges the opposing view and responds to it, which makes the argument feel more balanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"references to blind spots, merging, accidents, and state laws","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"Supports claims with multiple concrete details drawn from the article rather than relying mostly on general opinion."},{"evidence":"'who is to blame for accidents' and 'what if's'","quality":"reasoned analysis","description":"Extends evidence into implications and consequences, showing more explanation of why the position matters."},{"evidence":"final paragraph restates freedom, safety, and core skills","quality":"conclusion","description":"Ends by summarizing the main reasons in a way that reinforces the overall claim."}]}
